headline: Bitcoin is holding just above $73,000 after hot US inflation made a December Fed rate hike the market's base case; MSCI says at about 5pm ET Wednesday (05:00 Thursday Bangkok) whether it will drop Strategy from its indexes.

market.asOf: Read from CoinMarketCap (BTC), CoinGecko (ETH, SOL) and alternative.me at about 08:00 UTC Wed 11 Nov (15:00 Bangkok; 3:00am ET). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 32, Fear (alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index); 29 the day before

stories.title: Hot inflation pushed bitcoin to its lowest since August and made a December rate hike the base case
stories.summary: US consumer prices rose faster than forecast in October. Bitcoin fell below $73,000 for the first time since August, and traders now expect the Fed to raise rates on 9 December. Higher rates make borrowing dearer, which tends to weigh on risky assets like crypto.
points: Prices rose 0.4% in October against a 0.3% forecast; core prices (without food and energy) rose 0.3% against 0.2%, per CoinDesk.
CME FedWatch odds for a December hike: 85% for a quarter point and 15% for a half point, with no chance of a hold, per CoinDesk; 88.8% for a quarter point later on 10 Nov, per Investing.com.
The 10-year Treasury yield rose 15.2 basis points to 5.015% and the 2-year 21 basis points to 4.757%, per CoinDesk.
About $723M of crypto bets were forcibly closed in 24 hours, about $570M of them bets on rising prices, per CoinGlass data cited by crypto.news.

stories.title: Bitcoin funds lose money for a fourth day, and big holders keep selling
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds had net outflows again on Tuesday, though smaller than Monday's. Public companies, mostly bitcoin miners, have sold billions of dollars of bitcoin this year, and the biggest ether-holding company just reported a multibillion-dollar loss.
points: Tuesday 10 Nov: US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $95.0M net, the fourth day of outflows in a row, with BlackRock's IBIT down $78.2M, per SoSoValue data cited by KuCoin News.
Monday 9 Nov: about $201.1M left, with IBIT down $213.2M, per TFTC.
14 public companies have sold 108,247 BTC, about $8.08B, so far in 2026, per Lookonchain via CoinDesk.
Bitmine reported a net loss of more than $6.3B for the year to 31 August, mostly unrealized losses on the 5,901,837 ETH it holds, per The Block.

stories.title: MSCI decides today whether to drop Strategy, with bitcoin below Strategy's average cost
stories.summary: At about 5pm ET on Wednesday (05:00 Thursday Bangkok), MSCI announces its November index changes, which could remove companies whose main business is holding crypto, such as Strategy. Funds that copy the index would then need to sell the stock, and Strategy has been one of bitcoin's biggest buyers.
points: Results come shortly after 11:00pm CET Wed 11 Nov; changes take effect at the close on 30 Nov, per MSCI.
Strategy bought 1,036 BTC for $81.9M last week and now holds 850,364 BTC at an average cost of $75,456 each, per its SEC filing.
Strategy says its $4.77B cash reserve covers 3.4 years of interest and dividends, per Foreign Policy Journal.
JPMorgan estimated about $2.8B of outflows from an MSCI removal, an estimate made for an earlier version of the rules, per Tech Times.

briefs.title: Coinbase wins final approval for a national trust bank
briefs.summary: The OCC gave Coinbase National Trust Company final approval, moving its institutional custody under federal oversight; Coinbase said earlier it would not take retail deposits, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Crypto firms back the CFTC in a fight over stock perpetual futures
briefs.summary: Coinbase, Kalshi, Kraken's parent Payward and others asked a court to let them support the CFTC against a lawsuit challenging its approval of never-expiring futures on US stocks, per The Block.

briefs.title: Forward Industries adds to its Solana pile
briefs.summary: Forward Industries holds about 8.7M SOL and took a $50M bank loan backed by SOL that stays staked, as SOL hit a three-month low, per The Block.

briefs.title: Zcash drops despite a Grayscale ad push
briefs.summary: Grayscale ran a front-page Wall Street Journal ad for its Zcash fund and pledged $1M in grants, but ZEC still fell about 13%, per The Block.

briefs.title: Tron Inc profit rises
briefs.summary: Tron Inc's third-quarter net income rose 22% to $14.9M; it holds 723M TRX, per The Block.
